title: Search & social

fields.label: Title in search results
fields.name: seo_title
fields.instructions: About 50–60 characters. The headline Google shows and the browser tab title. Leave blank to use the page title followed by the business name.

fields.label: Description in search results
fields.name: seo_description
fields.instructions: About 120–155 characters. The short summary under the title in Google and when the page is shared. Write it for a person: what's on the page and why they'd click.

fields.label: Social sharing image
fields.name: seo_image
fields.instructions: Optional. Shown when this page is shared on WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Facebook etc. 1200 × 630 pixels. Leave blank to use the default image from Site Settings → SEO.

fields.label: Hide from search engines
fields.name: seo_noindex
fields.instructions: Tick to stop Google listing this page (e.g. thank-you pages). Account, basket and log-in pages are always hidden.

description: Title, description and image for Google and social sharing.
